solver: anchored exhaustive search with exclusions, two independent implementations (vsearch_orb.c, cluster2.c; github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ 2be467a7bd36, weight6-exact-distances)
encoding: cluster growth through unsatisfied X-checks with exclusions, unit propagation, majority rule over the Z-checks and sums of two overlapping Z-checks (Z side; the X side with X and Z exchanged); anchors: one per orbit of a Tanner-graph automorphism group of order 150 (two orbits per block), earlier orbits excluded (implementation A), the first block excluded for the anchors in the second block (implementation B); search through W = d - 2, parity of ker H_X and of ker H_Z

X.note: no nontrivial X-logical operator of weight <= 24 (W = 24); every element of ker H_Z has even weight (all column weights 3), so d_X >= 26. implementation A: 64150467 nodes, 392 s; implementation B: 441841057 generated states, 501 s
